info.description: MediConnect REST API. Envelope, error codes, idempotency and rate limits: mediconnect-docs/docs/api-specification.md §1.

AccountDeletionRequest.description: POST /auth/account/deletion-request: the current password confirms it is the account holder.
AccountDeletionRequest.title: AccountDeletionRequest

AddMemberRequest.description: POST /clinics/{id}/members: an existing MediConnect account, by email or mobile.

clinic_location_id.description: Null = every location of the clinic.

AddMemberRequest.title: AddMemberRequest

scan_status.description: Only CLEAN documents can be downloaded or reviewed.

submitted_at.description: When the doctor last submitted for review.

AssignDoctorRequest.description:
POST /clinics/{id}/doctors: invite a verified doctor to a location, found
by PRC licence number. The doctor must accept before the assignment counts.

prc_license_number.description: The doctor's PRC licence number (digits). Only verified doctors can be found.

AssignDoctorRequest.title: AssignDoctorRequest

ConfirmContactChangeRequest.description: PUT /auth/contact: the new email or mobile and the token from POST /auth/otp/verify.
ConfirmContactChangeRequest.title: ConfirmContactChangeRequest

CreateClinicRequest.description: POST /admin/clinics: a clinic in an existing or new organization, optionally with its first location.

latitude.description: No `sometimes`: sending one coordinate without the other must fail validation.

CreateClinicRequest.title: CreateClinicRequest

CreateDoctorServiceRequest.description: POST /doctors/me/services. The fee is in centavos (D-18): ₱650.00 is 65000.

clinic_location_id.description: Required for IN_PERSON (a location where you have an active assignment); not allowed for ONLINE.

clinic_service_id.description: Optional link to one of the location's clinic services.

fee_amount.description: Centavos. Every service publishes a fee (R-17); 0 means free.

CreateDoctorServiceRequest.title: CreateDoctorServiceRequest

CreateHolidayRequest.description: POST /clinics/{id}/holidays: a closure or special hours on one date.

clinic_location_id.description: Null applies to every location of the clinic.

CreateHolidayRequest.title: CreateHolidayRequest

latitude.description: No `sometimes`: sending one coordinate without the other must fail validation.

scan_status.description: Only CLEAN documents can be downloaded or reviewed.

DependentRelationship.description: How the dependent is related to the guardian (from the guardian's side: "my CHILD").
DependentRelationship.title: DependentRelationship

DoctorDecisionRequest.description: Verify or activate: step-up on the route and a reason, as for every step-up action (rbac-permissions.md §7).
DoctorDecisionRequest.title: DoctorDecisionRequest

fee_from.description: lowest fee among the matching services

fee.description: Fee in centavos, its currency and a display string such as "₱650.00".

is_hmo_eligible.description: Whether the doctor accepts HMOs for this service; coverage is never assumed (§12.10).

EndAssignmentRequest.description: End (or withdraw) an assignment: a short reason is kept with it.
EndAssignmentRequest.title: EndAssignmentRequest

verification_status.description: D-40: confirmed by a reviewer, or as stated by the doctor

specialty_review_pending.description: D-40: a verified doctor has specialty changes a reviewer has not confirmed yet.

OnboardingStatus.description: Doctor onboarding (CLAUDE.md §5.2). Only ACTIVE doctors can be booked or listed.
OnboardingStatus.title: OnboardingStatus

licence_verified.description: The PRC licence was checked by a MediConnect reviewer.
The PRC licence was checked by a MediConnect reviewer.

date_of_birth.description: D-37: account holders must be adults (minors are dependents).

accept_privacy_notice_version.description: The client must show and send the versions it displayed; stale apps are refused.

RejectDoctorRequest.description: POST /admin/doctors/{id}/reject: the reason is shown to the doctor so they can fix it.

more_documents.description: True asks for more documents rather than rejecting outright; the doctor may resubmit either way.

RejectDoctorRequest.title: RejectDoctorRequest

RequestContactChangeCodeRequest.description: POST /auth/contact/otp: the new email or mobile, and the current password.
RequestContactChangeCodeRequest.title: RequestContactChangeCodeRequest

note.description: Shown to the doctor; required when rejecting.

Role.description: Platform roles (CLAUDE.md §20.1). Roles are global labels; which clinics a clinic role applies to is held in clinic_members (D-17), not in Spatie teams.
Role.title: Role

Sex.description: Sex where clinically required (§4.3). Values follow the HL7 administrative gender set. Optional everywhere it is collected.
Sex.title: Sex

specialty_id.description: the parent specialty, for filtering doctor search

doctor_count.description: ACTIVE doctors with this confirmed specialty

StartDoctorOnboardingRequest.description: POST /doctors: start onboarding as a doctor (D-16: the patient profile stays).

display_name.description: The name patients see, for example "Dr. Ana Santos".

confirm_licensed.description: The applicant states they are a physician licensed by the PRC; verification follows.

StartDoctorOnboardingRequest.title: StartDoctorOnboardingRequest

guardian_attestation.description: The guardian confirms they are authorised to manage this person's health information.

guardian_attestation_version.description: The attestation version the app displayed; stale apps are refused.

SuspendUserRequest.description: Suspend or reactivate: sensitive, so a reason is required (rbac-permissions.md §7).
SuspendUserRequest.title: SuspendUserRequest

UpdateClinicRequest.description: PATCH /clinics/{id}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateClinicRequest.title: UpdateClinicRequest

UpdateClinicServiceRequest.description: PATCH /clinics/{id}/locations/{locationId}/services/{serviceId}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateClinicServiceRequest.title: UpdateClinicServiceRequest

UpdateDependentRequest.description: PATCH /patients/me/dependents/{id}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateDependentRequest.title: UpdateDependentRequest

UpdateDoctorServiceRequest.description: PATCH /doctors/me/services/{id}: a change ends this row and starts a replacement.
UpdateDoctorServiceRequest.title: UpdateDoctorServiceRequest

UpdateLocationRequest.description: PATCH /clinics/{id}/locations/{locationId}: only the fields sent change.

latitude.description: No `sometimes`: sending one coordinate without the other must fail validation.

UpdateLocationRequest.title: UpdateLocationRequest

UpdateMyDoctorProfileRequest.description:
PATCH /doctors/me. Scalar fields change only when sent; the lists
(languages, specialties, education, experience) replace the whole set.

prc_license_number.description: Digits only. Locked while under review and after verification.

languages.description: ISO 639 codes, for example en, fil, ceb.

UpdateMyDoctorProfileRequest.title: UpdateMyDoctorProfileRequest

UpdateMyPatientProfileRequest.description: PATCH /patients/me: only the fields sent are changed.
UpdateMyPatientProfileRequest.title: UpdateMyPatientProfileRequest

UpdateSettingRequest.description: PUT /admin/settings/{key}: any JSON value except null, and a reason.
UpdateSettingRequest.title: UpdateSettingRequest

UpdateSpecialtyRequest.description: PATCH /admin/specialties/{id}: only the fields sent change.

reviewed.description: A MEDICAL_ADMIN marks the entry as reviewed (D-39).

UpdateSpecialtyRequest.title: UpdateSpecialtyRequest

UpdateSubspecialtyRequest.description: PATCH /admin/subspecialties/{id}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateSubspecialtyRequest.title: UpdateSubspecialtyRequest

UpdateUserRolesRequest.description: PUT /admin/users/{id}/roles: the complete set of roles the user should hold, and why.
UpdateUserRolesRequest.title: UpdateUserRolesRequest

file.description: PDF, JPEG or PNG, checked by content as well as extension.

expires_on.description: Expiry printed on the document, if any (for example a PRC ID).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
